**1. Analyze the Proposition:**
The sentence is: "If the university does not increase financial aid, either the president fails to approve it or the board of trustees prevents it."

**2. Identify the Logical Structure:**
This sentence follows the structure: "If [A], then [B]".
*   [A] = "the university does not increase financial aid" (This is the condition or the hypothesis/antecedent).
*   [B] = "either the president fails to approve it or the board of trustees prevents it" (This is the consequent/result).

**3. Identify the Antecedent:**
The antecedent is the part of the conditional proposition that comes before the word "then" (or implicitly before the "if... then" relationship). It is the condition that, if true, necessitates [within this context] the consequent.
In "If P, then Q", P is the antecedent.
Here, P is "the university does not increase financial aid".

**4. Evaluate the Options:**
A. The university increases financial aid. (Incorrect, opposite of the text).
B. The university does not increase financial aid. (Matches P).
C. The board of trustees prevents it. (Part of the consequent).
D. The president fails to approve it. (Part of the consequent).
